item.title: Post match reaction…
item.description: NDF Mighty Gunners assistant coach, Mathias Haimbodi reflects on a hard fought 0-0 draw against FC Ongos in a FNB Women’s Super League match today in Windhoek.Video: Bravery Kabula

item.title: Result…
item.description: Bucks Buccaneers went down 3–1 to Okahandja United in their Namibia Premier League encounter at the Independence Stadium today.Photos: Limba Mupetami

item.title: Good game…
item.description: Namibia’s Codie van Schalkwyk speaks after losing his singles match to Estonia’s Markus Mölder in their Davis Cup World Group Two playoff tie at Central Tennis Courts in Windhoek.Video: Hilma Nalupe

item.title: Sympathy
item.description: Family members and neighbours gathered at the parents’ house of late Prosecutor Justine Shiweda in Omakulukuma Location, Ondangwa yesterday, mourning her passing.The Ondangwa Regional Control Prosecutor died yesterday in Windhoek.She died after being shot and attacked with a corrosive substance on 17 October 2025. Photos: Festus Hamalwa

item.title: arrest
item.description: The Anti-Corruption Commission yesterday confirmed that the mother of fugitive Victor Malima was arrested on Friday in the north. She was brought to Windhoek and will make a first court appearance tomorrow. She’s the 13th suspect in the Namcor corruption and fraud scandal. item.title: defeated
item.description: Namibia’s Davis Cup team suffered a 3-0 defeat against Estonia in their World Group Two playoff tie. Codie van Schalkwyk and Steyn Dippenaar were both beaten in their singles matches yesterday by Estonia’s Mark Lajal and Markus Mölder respectively. item.title: leaving…
item.description: Apollo Hangero parted ways with Khomas Nampol FC after a 12-year stint at the club. The 32 year old told New Era Sports his decision to leave the premier outfit was triggered by work and family related issues, adding that he will be playing for Omaheke Nampol (Omaheke Sports Club) in the second division. item.title: Match day…
item.description: The national Futsal team faces Libya today in the second leg of the Round two CAF AFCON qualifiers. The match will take place at the Misratah Multisport hall in Libya at 21h00.Photo: Futsal Namibia

item.title: arrival…
item.description: Prosecutor General Martha Imalwa, Oshana Governor Hofni Iipinge, Commissioner Naftal Sakaria and various prosecutors and magistrates arrived this afternoon at Onambango village to visit the family of the late prosecutor Justine Shiweda. Video: Festus Hamalwa

item.title: Nghimtina dies…
item.description: Former Minister of Works and Transport, Erkki Nghimtina died this afternoon at his homestead in Edundja village in the Ohangwena region.He was 78 years old. Ohangwena Regional Commander, Commissioner Ottilie Kashuupulwa confirmed the passing. Photo: Parliament
